keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «나무가 엽록소를 만들지 않아서 색이 변한다(원인)» 와 «가을 색은 나무가 겨울을 준비한다는 신호다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the cause (trees stop making chlorophyll) and the conclusion (autumn colors show that trees are getting ready for winter). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why do the yellow and orange colors finally show in autumn?
qs.qko: 가을에 노란색과 주황색이 마침내 보이는 이유는 무엇인가요?
opts: Because the green color breaks down
Because the tree makes more chlorophyll
Because the leaves get more sunlight
evs: As the green color breaks down, the hidden yellow and orange colors finally show.
There is so much chlorophyll that it covers up all the other colors.
Soon after, the leaves dry up and fall to the ground.
In autumn, many trees turn bright red, orange, and yellow.
why: 초록색이 사라지면서 숨어 있던 노란색과 주황색이 드러난다고 했어요. 나무는 엽록소를 더 만드는 것이 아니라 덜 만들어요.
The text says the hidden yellow and orange colors show as the green color breaks down. The tree makes less chlorophyll, not more.

qs.q: In «it covers up all the other colors,» what does «covers up» mean?
qs.qko: «it covers up all the other colors» 에서 «covers up» 은 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: During spring and summer, chlorophyll helps leaves use sunlight to make food for the tree.
As the green color breaks down, the hidden yellow and orange colors finally show.
Some trees, like maples, also make new red colors in autumn.
So the beautiful colors of autumn are a sign that trees are getting ready for winter.
why: 초록색이 사라지자 «숨어 있던» 색이 드러난다고 했으니, «covers up» 은 다른 색을 «가린다» 는 뜻이에요.
When the green color breaks down, the hidden colors show. So «covers up» means the green color hides the other colors.

qs.q: Why do leaves look green in summer even though they have yellow and orange materials?
qs.qko: 잎에 노란색과 주황색 물질이 있는데도 여름에 초록색으로 보이는 이유는 무엇인가요?
opts: There is so much chlorophyll that it hides the other colors
Yellow and orange materials appear only in winter
Maples make new green colors in summer
evs: However, leaves also contain yellow and orange materials all year long.
Some trees, like maples, also make new red colors in autumn.
There is so much chlorophyll that it covers up all the other colors.
Soon after, the leaves dry up and fall to the ground.
why: 잎에는 일 년 내내 노란색과 주황색 물질이 있지만, 엽록소가 너무 많아서 그 색들을 덮어 버려요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
Leaves have yellow and orange materials all year, but there is so much chlorophyll that it covers them up. You need both sentences to see this.

ends: Why do some trees stay green all winter?
Where does the red color in leaves come from?

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because they get ready for winter)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because they get ready for winter)
write.src: “I think <u>trees are smart</u> because <u>they get ready for winter</u>.”
